issues.entry: administrator terminal page with a running task
issues.setup: open a task after its log already contains buffered bytes and has been quiet longer than the display threshold
issues.action: select the task while xterm is still receiving the bounded replay
issues.expected: do not describe a visually changing replay as live task silence; reveal authoritative last-output age only after replay catches up
issues.observed: xterm rows visibly change while the selected header can already show an old age such as 27s
issues.owner: terminal websocket replay state and selected-header metadata
issues.verification: WebSocket output and caught_up frames now carry the authoritative log mtime. The selected running terminal suppresses age during bounded replay and starts the timer only after caught_up; browser acceptance verifies the age resets on new live output and remains absent for history.

issues.setup: drag across part of one xterm row
issues.expected: a solid pointer-anchored context menu offers Copy and copies exactly the xterm selection
issues.observed: selection creates a detached floating Copy selected button; right-click has no product-owned browser-like Copy action
issues.verification: The detached copy action was removed. A Radix Context Menu is anchored to the pointer, is disabled without a selection, and copies exactly the selected xterm text in both live and historical terminals; Edge, Chrome 84 and Firefox 78 acceptance passed.

issues.entry: command, verification, or third-party command plugin common fields
issues.setup: an environment script requires arguments when sourced from an automated shell, for example -env_path followed by its environment file
issues.action: describe the source operation in YAML and submit the task
issues.expected: one common source entry can carry a literal path plus an argv-safe argument list, remains task-private, and is visible in inspection and terminal lifecycle output
issues.observed: source accepts only path strings, so the required argument cannot be expressed without moving source into the user command
issues.verification: The common source contract accepts a string, structured mapping, or mixed list. Structured entries carry path plus argv-safe arguments through inspection, immutable task data, shell execution and lifecycle output; the real Bash target test sources a script that requires -env_path and verifies the imported environment.

issues.entry: command, verification, or third-party command plugin common source field
issues.setup: the operator already has one source statement that works in the selected interactive shell
issues.action: paste source setup.csh -env_path ./toolchain.env into the source field
issues.expected: the one statement is executed in the task shell without requiring a path/arguments object
issues.observed: the entire statement is treated as one literal filename and resolved beneath the task working directory
issues.reproduction: The public TaskCreate path failed twice on baseline a05831a: the complete statement was embedded as a resolved filename instead of appearing verbatim in the frozen shell body.
issues.verification: The primary form is now one YAML scalar containing the complete statement. Unit, plugin-inspection, API-detail and Ubuntu target tests preserve it end to end; Bash receives -env_path with a quoted-space argument, tcsh executes the raw statement, sh adapts source through a dot-based wrapper, a missing sh script fails immediately without entering an input prompt or running the user command, and legacy forms remain covered.
issues.interaction_economy: The normal configuration path changed from a mapping with path plus an arguments list to one pasteable scalar; no mode switch or secondary field is required.
